title: Quoting the Extra Time on a Keyturn Trip Booking Reservation
content:
The quote is the price of the extended time, with the young-driver share and the register lodgement charge added to it and the cover credit taken off it, taken as nothing where that comes out below nothing, and brought to the nearest cent again once those have been put together.

**The price of the extended time.** The price of the extended time is the locked daily rate of the Keyturn Trip Booking reservation lifted by the extension uplift, taken for each extended day, where the extended days are the extra time quoted divided by 24 and rounded up to the next whole day, never fewer than one day. The lifted daily rate is brought to the nearest cent, and the price of the extended time is brought to the nearest cent in its turn.

**The cover credit.** The cover credit is itself brought to the nearest cent when the credit for each extended day is taken for all of them.

**The quantities that enter it.** The standard extension uplift is 8 per cent. The extra time quoted is the longest further time the reservation can still take, which is 72 hours. No young-driver share is added as standard. No register lodgement charge is made as standard, which is to say the standard charge is 0.00 USD. No cover credit is given as standard, which is to say the standard credit is 0.00 USD for each extended day.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

*Hypothetical inputs: a reservation whose locked daily rate is 96.00 USD.*

The extra time quoted is 72 hours. Seventy-two hours divided by 24 is 3 exactly, so rounding up to the next whole day leaves 3 extended days, and the floor of one day does not bite. The locked daily rate of 96.00 USD lifted by 8 per cent is 103.68 USD, which is already at the cent, and taken for each of the 3 extended days that is a price for the extended time of 311.04 USD.

No young-driver share is added and no register lodgement charge is made, so nothing joins the 311.04 USD. The cover credit is 0.00 USD for each extended day, which over 3 extended days is 0.00 USD, so nothing comes off it. The figure is above nothing, and brought to the nearest cent once those have been put together the quote stands at **311.04 USD**.

*Hypothetical: the same reservation where the extra time quoted is 50 hours.* Fifty hours divided by 24 is a little over two, which rounds up to 3 extended days, and the quote is reached in the same way.

*Hypothetical: the same reservation where the extra time quoted is 9 hours.* Nine hours divided by 24 is less than one day, which rounds up to 1 extended day; the uplifted daily rate of 103.68 USD taken for that single day gives a quote of 103.68 USD.
